question: A train is travelling at the rate of 45 km/h. How many seconds it will take to cover a distance of frac{{4}}{5} km.
solution:
**Given:**

A train is travelling at the rate of 45 km/h.

Distance to cover = dfrac{4}{5} km

**Formula used:**

Time = dfrac{{Distance}}{{Speed}}

**Calculation:**

Speed = 45 km/h

Distance = \(\dfrac{4}{5} km\
